name: trailerfix-api
description: Esqueleto de API Node.js con autenticacion JWT

scripts.db:migrate: sequelize-cli db:migrate --config src/config/database.cjs --migrations-path src/database/migrations --models-path src/database/models --seeders-path src/database/seeders --env development
scripts.db:migrate:undo: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --config src/config/database.cjs --migrations-path src/database/migrations --models-path src/database/models --seeders-path src/database/seeders --env development
scripts.db:migrate:undo:all: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config src/config/database.cjs --migrations-path src/database/migrations --models-path src/database/models --seeders-path src/database/seeders --env development
scripts.db:seed: sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config src/config/database.cjs --migrations-path src/database/migrations --models-path src/database/models --seeders-path src/database/seeders --env development
scripts.db:seed:undo: sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --config src/config/database.cjs --migrations-path src/database/migrations --models-path src/database/models --seeders-path src/database/seeders --env development
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:migrate:undo:all && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
